name: kytea
description: Toolkit for analyzing text, especially Japanese and Chinese

repo.name: kytea
repo.description: The Kyoto Text Analysis Toolkit for word segmentation and pronunciation estimation, etc.

readme.summary: Extremely minimal README that only covers basic build steps, deferring all real documentation to an external website.
readme.top_issue: No usage examples or quick start — users must visit an external URL to learn anything about how to actually use the tool.

injection_risks.description: The getenv function is used to retrieve the KYTEA_MODEL environment variable, which could potentially be set by an attacker.
The parseRunCommandLine and parseTrainCommandLine functions do not appear to directly execute user input as shell commands, but they may be vulnerable to command-line argument injection attacks.

critical_findings: Potential command-line argument injection vulnerability in parseRunCommandLine and parseTrainCommandLine functions
Lack of input validation in setIOFormat function
security.summary: The KyTea codebase has some security concerns, including potential command-line argument injection vulnerabilities and lack of input validation, but no critical secrets or error exposure issues were found.

common_complaints: Compilation errors (-fPIC, linker failures, missing headers)
String length limit causing fatal errors
No releases despite fixes being available in PRs
praise_themes: Library functionality appreciated when it works
Interest in using as alternative to established tools (Mecab)
sentiment.summary: The project shows strong abandonment signals with unresolved build issues spanning 2019-2022, a stalled v0.4.7 release, and zero maintainer engagement despite users requesting release of fixes available in merged PRs.

communication.summary: The maintainer responses are clear, helpful, and patient. They provide technical depth and encourage new contributors.

concerns: Last commit was over 5 years ago (2020-04-03)
Zero active contributors in past 6 months
8 open issues with no recent activity or resolution
No recent releases or merged PRs
Complete stagnation with no indication of maintenance
maintenance.summary: kytea is abandoned with the last commit dating to April 2020 and zero development activity for over 5 years.

changelog.summary: The changelog is incomplete, not well-organized, and lacks clarity for users.
